messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: eu-west latency spike detected (95th p90 -> 980ms). Smart-routing recently increased 'economy' weight for eu-west by 40% 12m ago. Pager triggered -> paging @oncall-eu
maya.sre: on it. linking traces + qps. any visible error increase?
juan.infra: seeing increased tail lat and ~5% 5xx on a small set of tenants in eu-west. histogram pinned to requests hitting economy lane nodes.
lee.eng: confirmed. economy lane nodes are on smaller instances with aggressive pre-emption; KV cache misses up.
sarah.support: flagged 3 enterprise customers (acme-inc, stella-ai, snapshotlytics) reporting slow responses via support. CS asked for ETA.
ravi.prod: customer-impact = degraded interactive latency and occasional timeouts for long context calls (>4k tokens). Need fast mitigation, not full rollback.
maya.sre: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily reduce economy weight in eu-west 2) raise latency-priority weight 3) add per-tenant soft rate-limit for affected customers 4) monitor for regressions. Agree?
juan.infra: running quick override now:
```
# override weights
redwoodctl routing set-weight --region eu-west --tier economy --weight 0.15 --note "emergency reduce economy after tail latency spike"
redwoodctl routing set-weight --region eu-west --tier latency-priority --weight 0.65 --note "pull traffic to latency nodes"
```
juan.infra: applied. API returned: {"status":"ok","ops_id":"op-98765"}
maya.sre: ops-bot, start short 60s aggressive sampling on eu-west 95/99 percentiles and forward alerts to this thread.
ops-bot: Sampling enabled: eu-west.p95,p99 @60s. Live dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/d/ops/eu-west-latency (auth required)
lee.eng: seeing initial tail drop. p95 down to ~320ms after weight change. 5xx rate trending down. good sign.
sarah.support: messaged the three customers with a short update and ETA: 15-30m. CS wants note for postmortem.
maya.sre: also enabling a short per-tenant soft cap on the heaviest tenants to prevent retry storms. command: 
```
redwoodctl quota set --tenant acme-inc --region eu-west --rate 20rps --burst 40 --note "soft cap during mitigation"
```
juan.infra: quotas set for acme-inc & stella-ai & snapshotlytics.
ravi.prod: do we need to disable any optional features that hit economy lane (token-level reranking offload)?
lee.eng: yes, disable rerank-offload for eu-west for 20m:
```
redwoodctl features toggle --region eu-west rerank-offload --state off --ttl 20m
```
maya.sre: doing controlled handoff: @juan.infra you'll be primary for the next 30m for routing & infra. @lee.eng you'll own feature toggles. I'll stay on until postmortem started.
juan.infra: acknowledged, taking primary. paging policy updated.
ops-bot: Incident note recorded: incident-4123456789, severity: high, mitigation actions: weight override, tenant soft-caps, feature toggle. Link: https://incidents.redwood/internal/4123456789
sarah.support: customers notified. CS opened ticket references INC-4123456789.
maya.sre: quick impact summary for postmortem: cause = aggressive smart-routing economy weight bump + underprovisioned economy nodes for sudden qps pattern (cache churn). Impact = elevated p95/p99 in eu-west, ~3-7% 5xx for some tenants for 12-18m window, manual mitigations reduced impact. Actions: follow-up auto-throttle heuristics, emergency rollback threshold for economy weight, add capacity guard for economy lane, run replay tests.
ravi.prod: assign follow-ups to eng-runtime + infra + product to define rollback threshold & auto-eviction policy.
lee.eng: leaving small note: recommend decreasing cache TTL variance and add KV warming on lane shifts.
maya.sre: handoff to oncall-eu-night: @juan.infra will continue watch for 30m then pass to night. If we see a new p99 > 800ms for >5m, escalate to SEV-1 and re-open paging.
juan.infra: will escalate if needed. closing live mitigations in 22m unless metrics flip.
ops-bot: Mitigation window closed for live actions. Monitoring continues.
maya.sre: thanks team. I'll start the postmortem draft and include timestamps/commands/CS notes. good job. :white_check_mark:
